title: The long stairs
goals: Climb to the top of the stairs.
Do it in fewer than 4 lines.
starting_code: # Up and right, again and again, to the top.
hints: Each step of these stairs is the same two moves: up, then right.
Count the steps from the bottom to the top: that is the number for `range`.
Both moves go under the `for`, moved in by four spaces.
intro: These stairs go up to the night passages. Count the steps if you like; a loop will count them for you.
